validation.notes: Repair: packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts now encodes session directories per the documented contract (strip one leading separator, then replace '/', '\' and ':' with '-'), and packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts no longer re-implements that encoding - migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() resolves its destination via the existing exported getDefaultSessionDir(cwd, agentDir) from core/session-manager.ts, so writer and reader share one path contract. Before the fix the migration used [/:] (kept backslashes) while the reader used [/\] (kept colons), so any absolute POSIX cwd containing ':' or '\' - including Windows-style fragments like '/tmp/pi project/win\C:\Users\me:data/ete/日本' - was moved into a directory the reader never lists and the session became invisible. The regression script drives the real submitted modules through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (real migrations.ts, utils/text.ts, utils/paths.ts, core/session-manager.ts; only getAgentDir and readdirSync ordering are substituted): it writes legacy .jsonl files directly into the agent root and then verifies with the real reader (SessionManager.list, findById, open, loadEntriesFromFile) that the migrated file is discoverable for its cwd, that entry order, header cwd, Unicode text and exact bytes are preserved, that malformed lines are skipped while surrounding entries load, that a pre-existing destination file is never overwritten (collided source kept, other files for the same cwd still migrate), that two cwds mapping onto one encoded directory keep their own data, that a non-canonical spelling '/data/proj/./sub/' lands in the resolved lookup directory '/data/proj/sub', and that repeated migration is idempotent (no duplicates, no content churn). Determinism: fixed ids/timestamps, no clock, randomness, network or external services; fixtures live under .prale-eval/.tmp-regression and are removed in a finally block. Regression detection verified locally by restoring each production file alone to its pre-repair baseline: session-manager.ts baseline fails the encoded-name assertion (exit 1) and migrations.ts baseline fails 'migrated session must land in the canonical lookup directory' (exit 1); both are plain AssertionErrors, not crashes or import errors, and the repaired tree passes (exit 0) repeatedly. Limitation: the repository Vitest suites (e.g. packages/coding-agent/test/sdk-session-manager.test.ts, which asserts the same encoding) could not be run because node_modules is absent and dependency installation is out of scope; Node 24 plus the checked-in .prale-eval/subject.mjs was sufficient for the focused validation.
